newsitem.title: UK: BOC shares rebound, weakness overdone.
newsitem.headline: BOC shares rebound, weakness overdone.

text.p: Shares in health and industrial gases giant BOC Group Plc surged on Tuesday as analysts upgraded next year's profit forecasts on the back of today's results and said that recent share price weakness had been overdone.
The shares had risen 37-1/2p to 873-1/2p by 1435 GMT, in turnover of nearly 2-1/2 million shares, after an 11 percent rise in annual profits met with analysts best expectations.

"Cautious noises were being made ahead of the results and people downgraded their numbers," said David Ingles, analyst at HSBC James Capel. "Now the prospects look better than expected and analysts are putting their forecasts back up."

The shares had lost 30p in the two weeks prior to today's results statement. BOC issued cautious comments on two non-core operations, health and industrial vacuums, along with its third quarter results in August.
Ingles said he had waited for today's results before shaving next year's forecast but had cut his forecast from 460 million stg to 450 million stg to take account of the recent strength in sterling.
"The underlying profit rate has gone up a little but I have now incorporated the exchange rate into my numbers," he said.
"Today's figures were very good, but what I thought was wrong was the share price weakness ahead of the figures and today we're seeing a correction of what should never have happened."
